description: JSON Schema for Bluetooth Device Information. Sub-information, Link Layer packet information data types

interval_min.description: The minimum connection interval. (Multiplied by 1.25ms). This should technically be only between 7.5ms to 4.0s (6-3200) according to the spec, but put in whatever was actually used.

interval_max.description: The maximum connection interval. (Multiplied by 1.25ms). This should technically be only between 7.5ms to 4.0s (6-3200) according to the spec, but put in whatever was actually used.

latency.description: The Peripheral latency (how many connection events the Peripheral can skip replying to.). "The value of connSubrateFactor shall be in the range 1 to 500 and shall be set to 1 for a new connection" to be valid according to the spec, but put whatever value was actually found in the packet.

timeout.description: The connection timeout. (Multiplied by 10ms). "The connSupervisionTimeout shall be a multiple of 10 ms in the range 100 ms to 32.0s and it shall be larger than (1 + connPeripheralLatency) × connSubrateFactor × connInterval × 2." (so 1-3200)according to the spec, but put in whatever was actually used.

le_features_hex_str.description: An bit-array of LE supported features, 8 bytes long, defined in spec section "Feature Support" under Link Layer specification. Used by LL\_FEATURE\_REQ/RSP and as an optional AdvData type.

version.description:
One byte value indicating version of the BT Core Specification that this device comforms to.
 e.g. 0x06 = 4.0, 0x08 = 4.2, 0x09 = 5.0, 0x0D = 5.4 etc. See Assigned Numbers document. 
 Only setting an upper bound to enforce sanity checking that this is a single byte value.

company_id.description:
Company ID as assigned by Bluetooth SIG. See assigned\_numbers/company\_identifiers/company\_identifiers.yaml from https://bitbucket.org/bluetooth-SIG/public. 
 Only setting an upper bound to enforce sanity checking that this is a two-byte value.

subversion.description:
This is nominally the sub-version of the BT controller itself (i.e. hardware). This value is arbitrary, and picked by the hardware maker. 
 The correspondance of certain values to certain hardware is known for some vendors like Broadcom, but is unknown for most vendors.
 Only setting an upper bound to enforce sanity checking that this is a two-byte value.

0x32_LL_CS_REQ.description: Structure for LL\_CS\_REQ packet. Initiates a CS procedure using a previously created configuration. Refer to BT Core Spec Vol 6 Part B Section 2.4.2.47 for full field semantics.

opcode_str.description: This optional field is just for if you don't care about json file size and you want more human-readable JSON output.

opcode.description: This should always be 50. This is required to differentiate from other data types in an array.

config_id.description: 6-bit Config_ID field, used to select a created CS procedure configuration.

conn_event_count.description: 2-byte connEventCount field used as the reference for offset_min/offset_max.

offset_min.description: 3-byte Offset_Min field, the proposed minimum time in microseconds from the ACL anchor point of the referenced connection event to the start of the first CS subevent. Spec range is ≥ 500 µs and < 4 s.

offset_max.description: 3-byte Offset_Max field, the proposed maximum time in microseconds. Shall be ≥ offset_min and < the LE connection interval.

max_procedure_len.description: 2-byte Max_Procedure_Len field, the proposed maximum extent of the entire CS procedure in units of 625 microseconds.

event_interval.description: 2-byte Event_Interval field, the time in connection intervals between the start of two consecutive CS events offset directly from ACL anchor points. Spec range is 1-65535.

subevents_per_event.description: 1-byte Subevents_Per_Event field, the number of CS subevents in each CS event. Spec range is ≥ 1.

subevent_interval.description: 2-byte Subevent_Interval field, the gap in 625 µs units between the start of two consecutive CS subevents anchored from the same ACL anchor point. Valid only if subevents_per_event > 1; otherwise 0.

subevent_len.description: 3-byte Subevent_Len field, the maximum duration of each CS subevent in microseconds. Spec range is ≥ 1250 µs and < 4 s.

procedure_interval.description: 2-byte Procedure_Interval field, the time in connection intervals between the start of consecutive CS procedures. 0 indicates the procedure is to be run only once. Spec range is 0-65535.

procedure_count.description: 2-byte Procedure_Count field, the number of consecutive CS procedures to invoke. 0 indicates CS procedures shall continue until terminated. Spec range is 0-65535.

aci.description: 1-byte ACI field, the preferred Antenna Configuration Index to use in the CS procedure.

preferred_peer_ant.description: 1-byte Preferred_Peer_Ant bitmap. Per Table 2.40: bit 0 = first ordered antenna element, bit 1 = second, bit 2 = third, bit 3 = fourth.

PHY.description: 1-byte PHY field, indicating the remote device's Tx PHY to which pwr_delta applies. Bit meanings per Table 2.25 (same as LL_POWER_CONTROL_*).

pwr_delta.description: 1-byte Pwr_Delta field, the difference in dB between the remote device's transmit power level for CS tones and CS_SYNC packets and the transmit power for the PHY indicated. Signed integer; 0 means the two power levels are the same.

tx_snr_i.description: 4-bit TX_SNR_I field, the SNR output index to be used by the initiator in CS_SYNC packets in mode-1 and mode-3 steps. 0xF if SNR control is not to be used or is not supported by the initiator.

tx_snr_r.description: 4-bit TX_SNR_R field, the SNR output index to be used by the reflector. 0xF if SNR control is not to be used or is not supported by the reflector.

0x30_LL_CS_CONFIG_REQ.description: Structure for LL\_CS\_CONFIG\_REQ packet. Configures a CS procedure parameter set. Refer to BT Core Spec Vol 6 Part B Section 2.4.2.45 for full field semantics.

opcode_str.description: This optional field is just for if you don't care about json file size and you want more human-readable JSON output.

opcode.description: This should always be 48. This is required to differentiate from other data types in an array.

config_id.description: 6-bit Config_ID field, the CS configuration ID being configured. Per Table 2.32: values 0-3 are CS Configuration IDs; all other values RFU.

action.description: 2-bit Action field. Per Table 2.33: 0b00 = configuration is to be removed (all fields except config_id/action are RFU), 0b01 = configuration is to be created.

chm_hex_str.description: The 10-byte ChM (channel map) field, as a hex string (20 hex characters). Each bit represents one CS channel index per Vol 6 Part H Section 1: 1 = used, 0 = unused. At least 15 channels shall be marked as used.

chm_repetition.description: 1-byte ChM_Repetition field, the number of times the ChM field is cycled through for non-mode-0 steps within a CS procedure. Spec value is ≥ 1.

main_mode.description: 1-byte Main_Mode field. Per Table 2.34: 0x01 = Mode-1, 0x02 = Mode-2, 0x03 = Mode-3, 0xFF = None (applies only to sub_mode selection; RFU for main_mode selection).

sub_mode.description: 1-byte Sub_Mode field. Per Table 2.34: 0x01 = Mode-1, 0x02 = Mode-2, 0x03 = Mode-3, 0xFF = None.

main_mode_min_steps.description: 1-byte Main_Mode_Min_Steps field, the minimum number of Main_Mode steps before a Sub_Mode step. If sub_mode is None this field is RFU; otherwise spec range is 1 to N_STEPS_MAX - 1.

main_mode_max_steps.description: 1-byte Main_Mode_Max_Steps field, the maximum number of Main_Mode steps before a Sub_Mode step. Shall be ≥ main_mode_min_steps and ≤ N_STEPS_MAX - 1.

main_mode_repetition.description: 1-byte Main_Mode_Repetition field, the number of Main_Mode steps taken from the end of the last CS subevent to be repeated at the beginning of the next subevent. Spec range is 0-3.

mode_0_steps.description: 1-byte Mode_0_Steps field, the number of mode-0 steps at the beginning of each CS subevent. Spec range is 1-3.

cs_sync_phy.description: 1-byte CS_SYNC_PHY field, the transmit and receive PHY to be used for CS_SYNC exchanges. Per Table 2.35: bit 0 = LE 1M PHY, bit 1 = LE 2M PHY, bit 2 = LE Coded PHY, bit 3 = LE 2M 2BT PHY. Exactly one bit shall be set.

rtt_type.description: 4-bit RTT_Type field. Per Table 2.36: 0 = CS AA-only timing, 1 = 32-bit sounding sequence, 2 = 96-bit sounding sequence, 3 = 32-bit random sequence, 4 = 64-bit random sequence, 5 = 96-bit random sequence, 6 = 128-bit random sequence.

role.description: 2-bit Role field. Per Table 2.37: 0b00 = Initiator, 0b01 = Reflector.

ch_sel.description: 4-bit ChSel field. Per Table 2.38: 0b0000 = Channel Selection Algorithm #3b, 0b0001 = Channel Selection Algorithm #3c.

ch3c_shape.description: 4-bit Ch3cShape field, valid only when ch_sel is #3c. Per Table 2.39: 0x0 = Hat shape, 0x1 = 'X' shape.

ch3c_jump.description: 1-byte Ch3cJump field, a valid CSChannelJump value (Vol 6 Part H Table 4.2). Valid only when ch_sel is #3c.

t_ip1.description: 1-byte T_IP1 field, the T_IP1 index showing the selected duration of the interlude period used between CS_SYNC packets in mode-0 and mode-1 steps.

t_ip2.description: 1-byte T_IP2 field, the T_IP2 index showing the selected duration of the interlude period used between CS tones.

t_fcs.description: 1-byte T_FCS field, the T_FCS index showing the selected duration used for frequency changes.

t_pm.description: 1-byte T_PM field, the T_PM index showing the selected duration used for the phase measurement period of CS tones.

opcode_str.description: This optional field is just for if you don't care about json file size and you want more human-readable JSON output.

mode_types.description: 1-byte Mode_Types field, bitmap of optional CS modes supported. Per Table 2.27: bit 0 = Mode-3, all other bits RFU.

rtt_capability.description: 1-byte RTT_Capability field. Per Table 2.28: bit 0 = RTT_AA_Only_N meets 10 ns (vs 150 ns) accuracy, bit 1 = RTT_Sounding_N meets 10 ns accuracy, bit 2 = RTT_Random_Sequence_N meets 10 ns accuracy.

rtt_aa_only_n.description: 1-byte RTT_AA_Only_N field. Per spec, shall be non-zero. Value semantics depend on rtt_capability bit 0 (10 ns vs 150 ns accuracy).

rtt_sounding_n.description: 1-byte RTT_Sounding_N field. 0 indicates the device does not support RTT sounding.

rtt_random_sequence_n.description: 1-byte RTT_Random_Sequence_N field. 0 indicates the device does not support RTT random sequence.

nadm_sounding_capability.description: 2-byte NADM_Sounding_Capability bitmap. Per Table 2.29: bit 0 = phase-based NADM, bit 1 = amplitude-based NADM. A value of 0 indicates no NADM support availability.

nadm_random_capability.description: 2-byte NADM_Random_Capability bitmap. Same bit semantics as nadm_sounding_capability but for random-sequence CS_SYNC.

cs_sync_phy_capability.description: 1-byte CS_SYNC_PHY_Capability bitmap. Per Table 2.30: bit 1 = LE 2M PHY supported for CS_SYNC, bit 2 = LE 2M 2BT PHY supported for CS_SYNC.

num_ant.description: 4-bit Num_Ant field, the number of antenna elements available for CS tone exchanges. Spec range is 1-4.

max_ant_path.description: 4-bit Max_Ant_Path field, the maximum number of antenna paths supported. Spec range is 1-4 and shall be ≥ num_ant.

role.description: 2-bit Role field, the CS role options supported. Per Table 2.31: bit 0 = Initiator, bit 1 = Reflector.

bn_p_to_c.description: 4-bit BN_P_To_C (Peripheral-to-Central) Burst Number parameter, as defined in Section 4.5.13.2. Spec range is 0-15.
